title: I am the idea person. I don't have tools like most but if anyone wants a partner to make fun opensource MIT game ideas, contact me. Past GGJ winner.
author: c0wk1ng
selftext:
I have over two decades of hobby game design and development experience and well versed in all major game engines. 

I am going crazy with escatsy seeing all this super fast development in AI, I leverage AI as a tool. I rely on opencode, google search ai, duck.ai, perchance generators and lots of research.

If you are like me and want a thinking partner then help me leverage your tools/subscription/luxury to work together on new bigger and achieveable opensource (MIT) ideas that I can't develop on my own with my ducktape, glue and matchsticks.

If this post breaks rules, please delete. Thank you.

comments.author: Significant-Dog-8166
comments.body: I'm lost here.  What do you need other people for?

replies.author: bubbleofelephant
replies.body: OP needs someone else's claude subscription.

comments.author: askdoobie
comments.body:
Why do you only have "ducktape, glue and matchsticks" after  two decades of hobby game design and development experience?

  
Honest question. Are you underselling yourself? What do you have problems with? Actual game dev here.

replies.author: c0wk1ng
replies.body: I am just looking to team up. :)

replies.author: EyeAskedForIt
replies.body: They literally say what they want "help" with. "If you are like me and want a thinking partner then help me leverage your tools/subscription/luxury'. Another "Idea guy" who never had the idea to actually learn or do.

replies.author: askdoobie
replies.body: Shure, as a dev I know lots of "idea" guys. But I was once an idea guy myself. I understand you but there is no reason to be mean.

comments.author: Valdaraak
comments.body: *Everybody* is an idea guy. There's no value in just being an idea guy. We're in a time where the idea guy can actually do something meaningful in a development team. Get a subscription and do it.
